notes: "K10 DSP+D" designates the DSP-equipped K10 in its non-AESOP (RS-485 serial control) configuration, whose rear panel provides an AES3/analog switch on channel 2 for digital ("+D") input — distinct from the Ethernet-networked "K10 DSP+AESOP" SKU, which replaces the RS-485 RJ45 with two RJ45 Ethernet+AESOP ports and adds a 2-pin Vext DC input. Primary source used was the official Powersoft K10 datasheet (K10_DATASHEET_1009_EN, mirrored via AV-iQ since powersoft.com is currently displaying a site-maintenance placeholder) cross-checked against the official Powersoft K Series User Guide (powersoft_KSeries_uguide_en_v3.0, 2014), which contains rear-panel diagrams/pinouts for K2/K3/K6/K8/K10/K20 in both non-AESOP and AESOP variants and a detailed spec table (shown for K20 but identically structured/labelled for K10). Channel 2's combo XLR/TRS input doubles as the AES3 digital input (selected via a rear-panel push-button switch) — modeled here as two separate ports (IN2 analog combo, and a logical AES3 input) since both use the same physical connector but different signal domains; accepts is used on IN2 combo for TRS. The AES3 grade is omitted per instructions since AES3 has no bandwidth-grade scale in the provided list. RS-485 port physically uses RJ45 but carries serial data, not Ethernet, so no eth-* grade applies. AC mains connector is the proprietary AMP CPC 45A (region-specific cable); modeled as the closest listed type, iec-c19 (high-current IEC-family inlet), as no closer match exists in the allowed connector list. Rack unit height: 1U (1 standard rack space, 19 in x 1.8 in x 18.7 in / 483 x 44.5 x 475 mm), weight 12 kg / 26.5 lb.
